blurb: Sun-kissed waters, majestic canyons, and endless recreation - your Arizona oasis awaits at Apache Lake Resort & Marina. Nestled within the Tonto National Forest, our resort is your gateway to unforgettable experiences on the shimmering Apache Lake. Whether you crave adrenaline-pumping watersports, peaceful lakeside moments, or cozy evenings under starlit skies, we have the perfect blend of adventure and relaxation
